notes.title: Release of ReHack
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27992920/54328b71e794626ee0d03115f616ad83db2385e9.png
We are happy to announce, that spiritual successor of hack_me 2 has been released. We received your feedback on the second part of hack_me and by using it were able to develop a better product for you. We would be happy if you would be kind enough to give it a try.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/786180/ReHack/
